title: Starter Library & Golden Microgame/Aniloop Proof
objective: Define a small original starter library and deterministic golden Microgame/Aniloop proof composed only from frozen MAL-01..09 contracts, without copying proprietary game designs, creating parallel canonical owner truth, revealing hidden state or granting rewards.

rules: Every starter entry is an original MAL-local composition over frozen MAL-01..09 contracts; no proprietary map, encounter script, minigame logic, level design, reward table or hidden source payload may be copied.

Starter entries are deterministic reference/proof fixtures only and do not create or mutate canonical Character/NPC, World/Scene, Project/progression, Action/Event, Inventory/Asset, Combat, Travel, reward or Permission truth.
Traversal, interaction/objective, NPC state-machine, Aniloop, GCL bridge, owner-handoff/reward-boundary and accessibility/fallback examples may compose their frozen predecessor contracts only.
GCL bridge examples may use explicit authorized frozen GCL references only; unfinished GCL discovery, recommendation or composition-engine authority is not expanded.
Unknown, hidden or unauthorized owner-domain state remains unresolved and cannot be filled, guessed, auto-completed or revealed by starter content.

Golden proof must show the same semantic outcome and deterministic receipt for the same authorized semantic inputs, logical ticks and owner references across self-hosted Linux/Windows and permitted accessibility/device/presentation variants.
Presentation or raw-device variation never changes semantic truth; MAL-09 accessibility/fallback guarantees remain frozen.
MAL-local completion may prepare owner/reward handoff references only; canonical owner outcomes and reward grants remain outside MAL authority.
AI remains proposal-only and may not invent hidden state, proprietary source content, canonical outcomes or rewards.
